# Wise

> Wise provides international money transfers, multi-currency accounts, and payment solutions with transparent, low-cost fees for individuals and businesses worldwide.

Wise is a fintech platform specializing in cross-border payments and currency exchange. The platform serves both personal users and businesses with products including multi-currency accounts, international transfers, debit cards, and enterprise payment infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- International Money Transfers
- Multi-Currency Account
- Exchange Rates
- Transparent Pricing
- Wise Business
- Multi-Currency Card
- Currency Conversion
- API Integration
- FDIC Insurance
- Swift Payments
- APY Interest Rates
- Batch Transfers
- Volume Discounts
- Team Management
- Accounting Software Integration

## Personal Services

- [Wise: The international account | Money without borders](https://wise.com): Wise homepage showcasing international money transfers with low fees
- [International Money Transfer | Transfer Money Overseas](https://wise.com/us/send-money): Primary money transfer service page for international payments
- [Wise account: Multi-currency account | Foreign currency account](https://wise.com/us/account): Multi-currency account with 40 currencies and Wise card features
- [Wise: Receive and request money from abroad](https://wise.com/us/receive-money): Receive international payments via Swift and account details
- [Currency Card | Multi-Currency Card](https://wise.com/us/card): Wise Multi-Currency Card for spending in 160+ countries
- [Large Amount Transfers | Transfer Large Sums of Money](https://wise.com/us/large-amounts): Dedicated service for large international transfers with support
- [Meet Wise Interest - Wise](https://wise.com/us/interest): Wise Interest savings feature with FDIC insurance and APY rates

## Business Services

- [Wise Business: Grow with the international business account](https://wise.com/us/business): Business account for international payments and expense management
- [Cheaper, faster international payments with Wise Business](https://wise.com/us/business/invoices): Business invoice and vendor payment solutions with batch transfers
- [Receive international payments | Accept payments from overseas](https://wise.com/us/business/receive-money): Business payment reception with multi-currency conversion
- [Wise Multi-Currency Card for business - International Business Debit Card](https://wise.com/us/business/card): Business debit card for multi-currency expenses and team spending
- [Manage your team finances with Wise Business](https://wise.com/us/business/manage-team): Team management tools for business account access and spending
- [Earn 3.14% APY - Wise](https://wise.com/us/business/interest): Business account interest rates with FDIC insurance on balances
- [Wise Business App Marketplace. Sync Wise with your accounting software](https://wise.com/us/business/accounting-software): App marketplace integrations with accounting software automation

## Pricing & Reference

- [Wise Fees & Pricing: Only Pay for What You Use](https://wise.com/us/pricing): Transparent pricing and fee structure for all Wise services
- [Wise Business Fees & Pricing: Only Pay for What You Use](https://wise.com/us/pricing/business): Business pricing structure with transparent fees and discounts

## Developer & Enterprise

- [Wise API: seamless integrations for your business | Wise Business](https://wise.com/us/business/api): Wise Business API for developer integrations and automation
- [Wise Platform | Payments infrastructure to power the world's money](https://wise.com/platform): Enterprise platform for banks and institutions with payment APIs
